business_case: Truck check-in is done on paper, which creates queues at the gate and makes deliveries hard to track.
objective: Implement digital check-in at the gate by 31/05/2027, reducing the average service time from 20 to 8 minutes.
as_is: The driver fills in a paper form, and the gate team types the data into the system at the end of the shift.
to_be: The driver checks in on a tablet, and the data reaches the yard management system in real time.
product_scope: Check-in app on tablets at the gate, integrated with the yard management system.
in_scope: Integration with the yard management system
acceptance_criteria: Average service time of up to 8 minutes for 30 days
Gate team trained, with attendance list
assumptions: The gate will have Wi-Fi coverage during the rollout

functional_requirements.description: Record plate, carrier and invoice at check-in
Show the vehicle queue in real time

technical_requirements.description: Keep records during connection drops and sync them later

business_rules.description: A vehicle without a valid invoice cannot complete check-in

solution.description: Tablet app integrated through an API with the yard management system.

notes: Company, people and amounts are fictitious.
